reason: A is the better proposal because it specifies a controlled microstructural intervention, temperature window, baseline, measurable fracture/segregation outcomes, and a more decisive comparison. Its mechanism remains questionable—high strain rates limit diffusion, Ni/Cr/Mn are not generically grain-boundary embrittlers, and Cr-rich boundary precipitates may themselves embrittle—and neither candidate supplies the requested prior evidence, but B is substantially vaguer and its stress-induced precipitation mechanism is even less constrained.
